title: Phase 2.1a — HELIX P0+P1 Fixes: JWT guard, rate limiting, Zod validation
spec:
PHASE 2.1a: HELIX-HARDEN — P0 + P1 fixes

Apply the critical and high-priority fixes identified in the TASK-012 audit. These are scoped, safe changes that don't alter business logic.

LOCATION: platforms/serviceflow-sdm/

---

FIX 1 (P0): Fail boot if JWT secrets are default placeholders
- File: backend/src/config.ts (or wherever JWT_SECRET / JWT_REFRESH_SECRET are defined)
- Current behavior: Zod defaults to placeholder strings if env vars unset
- Required: At application startup, check if JWT_SECRET or JWT_REFRESH_SECRET equal their default/placeholder values. If so, log a FATAL error and exit the process (process.exit(1)).
- Do NOT remove the Zod defaults — just add a runtime guard after config loads.
- Example:
  ```typescript
  if (config.JWT_SECRET === 'change_me' || config.JWT_SECRET.length < 32) {
    console.error('FATAL: JWT_SECRET must be set to a strong secret in production');
    process.exit(1);
  }
  ```
- Allow bypass with NODE_ENV=development (so dev still works with defaults).

---

FIX 2 (P1): Add express-rate-limit
- Install: npm install express-rate-limit
- Apply rate limiting middleware to:
  a. /api/v1/auth/* — strict: 10 requests per 15 min per IP (login/refresh)
  b. All other write endpoints (POST/PATCH/PUT) — moderate: 100 requests per 15 min per IP
- Add as middleware in the main Express app setup (before route mounting).
- Configuration should be via environment variables with sensible defaults.

---

FIX 3 (P1): Add Zod validation to unvalidated write endpoints
- Salesforce POST /cases and PATCH /cases/:id — add Zod schema for request body
- Integration POST /webex/war-room — add Zod schema for the body (currently only manual trim)
- Follow the same pattern used in existing validated routes (incidents, properties, devices)
- Return 400 with clear error messages on validation failure

---

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT change existing route behavior or business logic
- Do NOT modify database schema or migrations
- Do NOT touch frontend, mobile, or Docker
- Run `npm run build` in backend/ after changes to verify TypeScript compiles
- List all files changed in the result

TESTING:
- After all fixes: cd backend && npm run build
- If build succeeds, report success
- If build fails, fix the error before reporting
